answer: Three options. (1) Upsert sink keyed by product and window start, so the replayed emission overwrites the pre-crash row and the latest wins. (2) Transactional sink that commits output in the same transaction as the checkpoint offsets, so post-checkpoint writes from before the crash are never committed. (3) Dedupe view on the read side: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, window_start ORDER BY emitted_at DESC) = 1, keeping the latest emission per key. Prefer an upsert sink when supported, because the latest-row view adds a window function to every query. The view is the fallback for append-only sinks.
